origin.complextalents.warrior.desc: Frontline combat master with Iron Skin defense. Gains +0.30 to +1.20 base armor per character level. Perfect parries refund 100% Stamina, reset guard penalties, and unleash path-specific combat bonuses (Blademaster: +15-35% AD, Colossus: Shockwave, Reaper: 100% Crit, Juggernaut: +20-40% AS, Vanguard: +25-65% Poise Damage, Brawler: +20-40% Movement Speed).
origin.complextalents.warrior.gun_msg.1: GRAGH! Where the fuck is the blade?! How the hell do I smash skulls with a tiny dinky hammer?!
origin.complextalents.warrior.gun_msg.2: This piece of shit iron rod has zero heft! Fuck this, real men fight with giant bloody broadswords!
origin.complextalents.warrior.gun_msg.3: You yank the tiny trigger lever. CLICK. What a pathetic, limp dick of a weapon!
origin.complextalents.warrior.gun_msg.4: Fuck this metal pipe! I'm gonna beat them to death with the buttstock!
origin.complextalents.warrior.gun_msg.5: You try to swing it like a club. It feels like a clumsy, worthless chunk of pig iron.
origin.complextalents.spellblade.desc: Master of fusing magic and swordplay in Spell Weaver style. Melee slashes restore 6%-15% max Mana and gain Percentage Attack Damage (% AD) equal to 10%-30% of Spell Power. Spells imbue elements onto your weapon for 6s. In Overcharge, fast spells cast instantly (0s), elemental effects are boosted 1.25x-1.90x, and imbue expiration or switching element at >50% duration grants a Free Cast.
origin.complextalents.spellblade.gun_msg: Fascinating... such flawless metalwork and iron balance! But where the fuck do you channel your power?!
Incredible craft... yet when I channel elemental fire, the fucking barrel just burns my fingers! How?!
By the Seven Hells, what a magnificent metallic box! ...Wait, how the hell does it strike without an edge?!
Astonishing assembly... but it won't conduct a single spark of magic! What sorcery is this?!
You pull the lever in awe... CLICK. Beautiful steel, yet completely inert. How utterly baffling!
origin.complextalents.high_priest.desc: Zealot messenger of Holy Light. Cannot swing melee weapons, but holy spells deal 2x damage. Remaining safe for 30s grants 20%-60% Cast Speed and 30%-125% Healing Potency. Spending 5 Mana yields 1 Command point to refund up to 20% Mana and trigger Seraphic Echo.
origin.complextalents.high_priest.gun_ms: BY THE HOLY LIGHT! What profane, godless monstrosity of foul iron is this?!
Goddess damn this blasphemous metal filth! It lacks all divine spirit and smells of sulfur!
You peer straight down the dark, unholy hollow tube. May the Heavens smite whichever heathen forged this curse!
Foul heresy! Is this wretched contraption a mockery of sacred artifice?! It produces only a dismal click!
Begone, dirty piece of scrap! The Goddess will judge whoever brought this demonic trinket here!
origin.complextalents.elemental_mage.des: Master of elemental forces. Triggering reactions grants +25% to +130% reaction damage. Accumulate up to 3 Elemental Seals to burst Harmonic Convergence, boosting spell damage by 1.15x-1.5x, crit chance up to +60%, and crit damage by +100% for 10s.
origin.complextalents.elemental_mage.gun: Remarkable mechanical composition, yet profoundly lacking any magical flow. What a bizarre failure.
You analyze the internal chamber. No runes, no catalysts... what a foolishly crude construct.
Peculiar... I calculated an explosive blast, yet produced a mere, pathetic mechanical click. Damn it.
By the laws of nature, who forged such an inert piece of junk? It defied all my expectations!
An absurdly convoluted metal tube that fails to ignite a single spark. Utterly ill-conceived.
origin.complextalents.dark_mage.desc: Practitioner of dark magic building 0-100 Arcane Entropy instead of spending Mana. Spells generate 10-20 Entropy; Blood spells consume 15%-25% current HP to flush 20-40 Entropy. Crossing 85%-65% Entropy threshold empowers Eldritch spells by 1.5x-2.5x, but premature casting causes backfire self-damage and silence.
Foolish iron... Where is the power?! I demand real strength, not cold dead metal!
You whisper forbidden curses into the barrel... It remains mockingly silent. Fuck this useless scrap!
You sacrifice a drop of dark blood onto the chamber... It merely stains. What a pathetic, soul-less vessel!
I shall tear down my enemies with dark magic—not this worthless piece of iron garbage!
What wretched smith dared present me a weapon completely void of evil?!
origin.complextalents.assassin.desc: Stealth burst assassin. Backstabs apply Expose Weakness, causing the entire team to deal +30% to +80% extra damage to the target for 8-16s. Attacking from stealth triggers Disengage, boosting movement speed by 30%-100% for 1.5-2.5s.
origin.complextalents.assassin.gun_msg.1: How utterly crude... A loud, clumsy box of iron. What a dreadful insult to the art of assassination.
origin.complextalents.assassin.gun_msg.2: You inspect the spring mechanism with graceful precision. You find no hidden blade... only foul, black grease. Tch.
origin.complextalents.assassin.gun_msg.3: How in damnation is one supposed to slit a throat silently with such a vulgar, heavy paperweight?!
origin.complextalents.assassin.gun_msg.4: A single click... and every bloody guard in the courtyard knows your position. How utterly primitive.
origin.complextalents.assassin.gun_msg.5: No balance, no subtle edge. I would far rather drive a hairpin through their eye than touch this trash.
origin.complextalents.pixie.desc: Invulnerable support fae companion tethered within 6-10 blocks of allies. Possess an ally to grant +10% to +35% attack power, +5% to +25% defense, grant shields, and mark enemies for magic explosions.
origin.complextalents.pixie.gun_msg.1: Eew gross! It's super heavy, super greasy, and stinks like old shit!
origin.complextalents.pixie.gun_msg.2: Hey! This stupid metal brick is pulling me down into the mud, damn it!
origin.complextalents.pixie.gun_msg.3: Ugh! You sprinkle fairy dust into the tube. Now it's just a sparkly, useless piece of crap!
origin.complextalents.pixie.gun_msg.4: Yuck! What kind of brute carries around a dirty, noisy iron pipe?!
origin.complextalents.pixie.gun_msg.5: You pull the little latch... Click! That's it?! What a fucking ripoff!
origin.complextalents.marksman.desc: An outworlder hero transported from another world, the sole master capable of operating modern firearm technology (TACZ guns) in a world of swords and magic. Suffers a 50% reduction to total Max Health.
origin.complextalents.default.gun_msg.1: What in the blazes is this strange metallic object?
origin.complextalents.default.gun_msg.2: You stare at the metal tube, pull the trigger, and produce a dull click.
origin.complextalents.default.gun_msg.3: Is this supposed to be a weapon? How do you even hold this bloody thing?
origin.complextalents.default.gun_msg.4: You yank the lever and nothing happens. You consider throwing the useless metal pipe.
skill.complextalents.seraphic_echo.desc: Divine Orb: Move the seraphic orb to a target location. Damages and slows enemies, while granting speed and absorption to allies on its path. Cast on the orb itself to pull nearby enemies.
skill.complextalents.shadow_walk.desc: Phase into the shadows to become nearly invisible. Gain increased movement speed and a massive damage bonus on your next strike.
skill.complextalents.blood_pact.desc: Toggle to fuel magic with life force. Grants soul-scaled mana regen and massive power. Phylactery (Death-Defy) is free while active, but dying costs 30% of souls.
skill.complextalents.harmonic_convergenc: Converge your elemental echos to restore mana and supercharge your next spell with increased critical strike chance and damage.
skill.complextalents.challengers_retribu: Adopt a defensive stance, taunting nearby enemies into a magical shield. Release the charge to unleash all absorbed damage in a powerful burst.
origin.complextalents.marksman.rpg_msg: This is strictly prohibited under international law.
guide.complextalents.stages.title: §6Stages of Battle§r
guide.complextalents.stages.p1: §6Stages§r are §cmandatory, timed trials§r that cannot be skipped. When the countdown ends, you are pulled into a §brift§r to face waves of elemental monsters and a final §cBoss§r. Preparing your gear, weapon masteries, and spells beforehand is crucial; once the timer runs out, you must be ready.
guide.complextalents.stages.p2: Successfully clearing a stage raises the §6World Level§r, making overworld monsters stronger. Higher-level enemies gain deeper health pools, deal more damage, and possess §bpoise shields§r that block stagger effects unless shattered with heavy strikes. Each stage is aligned with a specific §belement§r; using §acounter-elements§r, such as Water against Fire, is key to breaking enemy shields and surviving.
guide.complextalents.stages.p3: Failing a stage triggers a §cGame Over§r. This resets the §6World Level§r, rerolls your upcoming stages, and returns you to Stage 1. Upon defeat, you §close 60-80% of your progression§r and §call items§r carried into the rift. However, you can §areclaim§r your lost items by fighting your way back and successfully defeating the exact stage where you failed.
guide.complextalents.mastery.title: §6Mastery Systems§r
guide.complextalents.mastery.intro: Specializing in different combat arts requires training and dedicating resources. By dealing damage using physical, ranged, or magical styles, you accumulate experience that unlocks the ability to buy mastery levels using §aSkill Points (SP)§r.
guide.complextalents.mastery.melee.title: §6Weapon Mastery (Melee)§r
guide.complextalents.mastery.melee.bulle: • Earn §bWeapon Experience§r by dealing damage with melee weapons to unlock upgrades.
• Wielding higher-tier weapons requires purchasing corresponding ranks:
• Your origin lineage may modify SP costs depending on your natural affinity.
guide.complextalents.mastery.gun.title: §6Gun Mastery (Ranged)§r
guide.complextalents.mastery.gun.bullet1: • Firearm expertise is split into distinct gun archetypes. Everyone starts with §fPistols§r.
guide.complextalents.mastery.gun.bullet2: • Reach §bLevel 5§r in Pistol mastery to unlock other firearms (§eSnipers, Rifles, Shotguns, SMGs, MGs§r).
guide.complextalents.mastery.gun.bullet3: • Deal damage with a gun type to unlock upgrades and military ranks:
guide.complextalents.mastery.gun.bullet4: • §cWarning: Specializing in multiple paths is expensive!§r Unlocking level 5+ in multiple non-pistol archetypes increases the SP cost of subsequent gun upgrades.
guide.complextalents.mastery.spell.title: §6Spell Mastery (Magic)§r
guide.complextalents.mastery.spell.bulle: • Spells are divided into rarity tiers: §fCommon§r, §aUncommon§r, §9Rare§r, §5Epic§r, and §6Legendary§r.
• Learn the corresponding rarity tier to cast a spell from your mind. Scroll consumption bypasses this restriction.
guide.complextalents.mastery.spell.learn: - §aIn-Chat Quick Learning§r: Learn spells instantly from unlearned cast attempts at reduced SP cost (Common: 1, Legendary: 7). Does not grant physical scrolls.
- §bProgression UI Purchase§r: Purchase scrolls directly (Common: 2, Legendary: 15).
guide.complextalents.mastery.spell.bulle: • §eUpgrade Discounts§r: Upgrading a spell rarity tier only costs the difference in SP, modified by magical school affinities.
• §cEldritch spells§r are forbidden; only Dark Mages and Spellblades possess the affinity to learn and cast them.
guide.complextalents.refinement.title: §6Refinement Systems§r
guide.complextalents.refinement.intro: Enhance melee weapons, firearms, and magical gear at the §eRefining Anvil§r. Convert §eGems§r to accumulate Refinement XP (Common: 100 XP, Legendary: 409,600 XP). As gear gains XP, its refinement level increases (up to level 20), boosting primary stats and permanently unlocking random §bsub-stats§r at levels 1, 3/5, 5/9, 8/13, and 12/17.
guide.complextalents.refinement.melee.bu: • Primary Bonus: Up to §e+600% Attack Damage§r at level 20.
• Tiers: Divided into 5 Tiers: §7Novice§r, §aApprentice§r, §9Adept§r, §5Expert§r, and §6Master§r. Reaching the max refine limit of your tier allows §aAscension§r to the next tier (starts at +1).
• Sub-stats: Unlocked at levels 1, 3, 5, 8, and 12 (e.g. flat damage, critical strike chance/damage, armor, max health, armor shred/pierce, or impact).
guide.complextalents.refinement.gun.bull: • Primary Bonus: Up to §e+225% Gun Damage§r at level 20.
• Ranks: Divided into 5 military ranks: §7Recruit§r, §aTrooper§r, §9Sergeant§r, §5Captain§r, and §6General§r (4 levels each).

• Sub-stats: Unlocked at levels 1, 5, 9, 13, and 17 (e.g. headshot damage, fire rate, reload speed, recoil control, ADS speed/accuracy, hip fire accuracy, draw speed, and ammo saving. Bolt-action/pump-action guns can also roll bolt action speed).
guide.complextalents.refinement.magic.bu: • Primary Bonus: Catalysts/Spellbooks gain up to §e+200% Spell Power§r; Spell Scrolls gain up to §e+150% Spell Damage§r and §b-50% Mana Cost§r at level 20.
• Ranks: Divided into 5 ranks: §7Attuned/Inscribed§r, §aResonant/Illuminated§r, §9Radiant/Enchanted§r, §5Astral/Gilded§r, and §6Sovereign/Transcendent§r (4 levels each).

• Sub-stats: Unlocked at levels 1, 5, 9, 13, and 17 (e.g. cooldown reduction, mana regeneration, spell critical hits, or summoning/healing power). Scroll sub-stats are tailored to the spell type (summoning rolls only on summons, mana stats do not roll on scrolls).
guide.complextalents.spellshield.title: §6Spell-Shield Reactions§r
guide.complextalents.spellshield.intro: Enemies and bosses possess an elemental §bPoise Shield§r that mitigates incoming damage. Shattering this shield staggers the target, rendering them vulnerable to full, unmitigated damage from all sources.
guide.complextalents.spellshield.element: - Fire counters Nature • Nature counters Aqua • Aqua counters Lightning • Lightning counters Ice • Ice counters Fire.
- Nature resists Fire • Aqua resists Nature • Lightning resists Aqua • Ice resists Lightning • Fire resists Ice.
• §cArcane Backfire§r: Casting an arcane spell against an enemy of the same element converts the damage into §aPoise Healing§r, restoring their defenses. Avoid matching arcane schools against targets of the same element.
- §eHoly (Smite)§r: Deals increased poise damage the higher the target's current shield is.
- §dEvocation (Soul Rend)§r: Deals increased poise damage the lower the target's shield is.
- §5Ender (Execution)§r: Deals double health damage if the shield is shattered; otherwise deals 0.5x poise damage.
- §dEldritch (Entropy Nuke)§r: High Entropy stacks trigger a massive damage nuke, but insufficient stacks backfires, damaging and silencing the caster.
- §cBlood (Lifesteal)§r: Heals for 25% of damage dealt. Rapid casting inflicts §cBlood Exhaustion§r, reducing lifesteal by 33.3% per stack.
guide.complextalents.reactions.title: §6Elemental Reactions§r
guide.complextalents.reactions.intro: Elemental reactions trigger when a new element is applied to a target already carrying a different element stack. Elemental stacks can only be applied to targets by casting spells of the corresponding magic school. An entity can only hold one elemental stack at a time, which is consumed upon triggering a reaction.
guide.complextalents.reactions.vaporize: • §6Vaporize§r (§cFire§r + §9Aqua§r): Deals moderate elemental damage to the target.
guide.complextalents.reactions.melt: • §6Melt§r (§cFire§r + §bIce§r): Deals high elemental damage to the target.
guide.complextalents.reactions.overload: • §6Overload§r (§cFire§r + §eLightning§r): Deals moderate damage and triggers a violent electrical explosion that knocks the target high into the air.
guide.complextalents.reactions.burning: • §6Burning§r (§cFire§r + §aNature§r): Deals minor damage and inflicts a burning damage-over-time effect for §e3 seconds§r.
guide.complextalents.reactions.freeze: • §bFreeze§r (§bIce§r + §9Aqua§r): Encases the target in solid ice for §e2 seconds§r, completely preventing movement. The next physical hit deals §e2.5x damage§r and shatters the ice.
guide.complextalents.reactions.supercond: • §bSuperconduct§r (§bIce§r + §eLightning§r): Deals minor damage and corrodes target armor, reducing it by §c50%§r for §e6 seconds§r.
guide.complextalents.reactions.permafros: • §bPermafrost§r (§bIce§r + §aNature§r): Deals minor damage and roots the target in place, preventing all movement for §e2 seconds§r.
guide.complextalents.reactions.electroch: • §9Electro-Charged§r (§9Aqua§r + §eLightning§r): Deals minor damage and applies chain lightning that zaps up to 3 nearby enemies every second for §e5 seconds§r.
guide.complextalents.reactions.bloom: • §2Bloom§r (§9Aqua§r + §aNature§r): Spawns 3 Nature Cores around the target. Cores explode when struck by Fire or Lightning, or self-detonate after §e4 seconds§r.
guide.complextalents.reactions.overgrowt: • §aOvergrowth§r (§eLightning§r + §aNature§r): Afflicts the target with Unstable Bio-energy for §e3 seconds§r. If the target dies, they explode, dealing AoE damage in a §e5-block radius§r.
guide.complextalents.stats.title: §6Stats & Attributes§r
guide.complextalents.stats.intro: Several custom stats and attributes shape the path of combat, magic, and summoning. These attributes can be permanently enhanced through origin lineages, weapon or magic refinements, or by directly investing Skill Points (SP) in the progression menu.
guide.complextalents.stats.flat_ad: • §6Flat Attack Damage§r: Adds §e+0.5§r flat Attack Damage per rank. Directly increases base melee weapon swing damage.
guide.complextalents.stats.percent_ad: • §6% Attack Damage§r: Adds §e+3%§r Attack Damage per rank. Multiplies total physical melee attack damage.
guide.complextalents.stats.max_hp: • §cMax HP§r: Adds §e+2.0§r Max HP per rank. Permanently increases your health pool and survivability.
guide.complextalents.stats.ap: • §5Ability Power (AP)§r: Adds §e+5%§r Spell Power per rank. Boosts the raw potency and damage of all spells.
guide.complextalents.stats.max_mana: • §bMax Mana§r: Adds §e+50.0§r Max Mana per rank. Expands the player's mana pool for longer casting sustain.
guide.complextalents.stats.cdr: • §dAbility Haste§r: Adds §e+5.0§r Ability Haste per rank. Scales into Cooldown and Cast Time Reduction percentage using the formula: Haste / (100 + Haste).
guide.complextalents.stats.heal_and_shie: • §aHeal & Shield Power§r: Adds §e+10%§r Heal & Shield Power per rank. Linearly scales all healing and shielding spell outputs.
guide.complextalents.stats.summoning_pow: • §2% Summoning Power§r: Adds §e+5%§r Summoning Power per rank. Scales the Max Health and Attack Damage of summoned entities additively.
guide.complextalents.stats.magic_effecti: • §dMagic Effectiveness§r: Adds §e+5.0§r Magic Effectiveness per rank. Mitigates the Spell Power Penalty (which increases mana cost and cast time when bonus spell power exceeds the +100% threshold) using diminishing returns.
guide.complextalents.stats.gun_damage: • §6% Gun Damage§r: Adds §e+1.5%§r Gun Damage per rank. Boosts all damage dealt by firearms.
guide.complextalents.stats.reload_speed: • §e% Reload Speed§r: Adds §e+2%§r Reload Speed per rank. Shortens reloading duration, keeping you in the fight.
guide.complextalents.stats.fortitude: • §9% Fortitude§r: Adds §e+2.5%§r Heart Rate Fortitude per rank. Stabilizes heart rate to minimize gun recoil and weapon sway.
guide.complextalents.stats.headshot_dama: • §c% Headshot Damage§r: Adds §e+2.5%§r Headshot Damage multiplier per rank. Increases the bonus damage dealt on precise headshot hits.
guide.complextalents.stats.recoil_contro: • §b% Recoil Control§r: Adds §e+2%§r Recoil Control per rank. Reduces both vertical and horizontal weapon recoil on active firing.
guide.complextalents.stats.bullet_penetr: • §6% Bullet Penetration§r: Adds §e+2%§r Bullet Pierce multiplier per rank. Allows firearm rounds to pierce through more enemies.
guide.complextalents.stats.fire_rate: • §e% Fire Rate§r: Adds §e+1.5%§r Fire Rate per rank. Increases the rounds-per-minute (RPM) of firearms.
guide.complextalents.stats.luck_crit: • §aLuck & Crit§r: Adds §e+0.2§r Luck, §e+2.5%§r physical Crit Chance, and §e+2.5%§r Spell Crit Chance per rank. Perfect for critical-strike-focused playstyles.
guide.complextalents.mechanics.title: §6Game Mechanics§r
guide.complextalents.mechanics.p1: §6Poise System§r: Most monsters and all §cBosses§r possess a hidden §bPoise Shield§r that prevents them from being staggered. Heavy physical attacks or specialized spells drain their poise. When shattered, the enemy is §astaggered§r, briefly stunned, takes increased damage, and loses passive defenses.
guide.complextalents.mechanics.p2: §6Hardcore Lives§r: Your team shares a limited pool of §cHardcore Lives§r. Every player death consumes one life. If the pool is completely depleted, any subsequent casualty triggers a team-wide §cGame Over§r. Protecting teammates is vital to preventing a run reset.
guide.complextalents.mechanics.p3: §6Player Revive§r: Upon losing all health, you enter a §bDowned State§r where you cannot move or use skills. Nearby teammates must stand close and interact to §arevive§r you before your bleed-out timer ends, preventing the loss of a shared hardcore life.
guide.complextalents.mechanics.p4: §6Target Switching§r: Once a monster switches targets, it locks onto them for §b5 seconds§r. To avoid getting targeted, pace your attacks and control your burst damage (health + poise) when a teammate is tanking. Additionally, firing unsilenced guns will immediately alert and draw nearby enemies. Fight cautiously, as you cannot instantly shake off a monster once it has locked its sights on you.
